indicator_name: Supply and use balances of the main agricultural products (grain, meat, milk, eggs, potatoes, fruit, sugar beet, sunflower seed, oils)
description: Баланс ресурсов и использования основных продуктов сельского хозяйства
unit: as in item_name: thousand tonnes (eggs: million pieces); per head kg or pieces a year; kcal a day; percent
methodology: BNS publication 19517, national, 2017 onward; the latest edition covering a year wins (livestock 2022-2023 revised in the 2025 edition). Item «<PRODUCT>.<ARTICLE>»: STOCK_BEGIN, PROD, IMP, RES, PROD_USE (FEED, SEED, INCUB), FOOD_PROC, OTHER_IND, LOSS, EXP, CONS, CONS_PC, KCAL, STOCK_END, STOCK_CHG, IMPORT_SHARE.
